content.text: I pulled your current course progress and deadlines, and checked your calendar for the week of Dec 22–28. I trimmed the study plan to exactly 8 hours, weighted toward Coursera ML Capstone and edX Intro to Python to stay ahead of their upcoming deadlines, and avoided Christmas Day. The grid reflects evening-focused blocks with a modest Saturday session, aligned to your availability. The dashboard summarizes percent complete, remaining hours, and the next lesson for each course so you can see where time is going at a glance. If you’d like me to shift time among days or tighten the weekday blocks, I can adjust quickly.

tool_definitions.name: get_user_courses
tool_definitions.description: Fetch the list of a user’s enrolled courses from connected learning platforms, optionally including progress details and time estimates.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user whose courses to fetch

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Optional filter for a specific learning platform (e.g., coursera, udemy, edx)

parameters.name: include_progress
parameters.description: Whether to include progress and time remaining details for each course

tool_definitions.return_type: List of course objects: [{ id, title, platform, url, total_units, completed_units, percent_complete, estimated_hours_remaining, last_activity_at }]

tool_definitions.name: get_calendar_events
tool_definitions.description: Retrieve a user’s calendar events for a date range to determine availability for scheduling.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user whose calendar to query

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start of the date range in ISO 8601 format

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of the date range in ISO 8601 format

parameters.name: calendars
parameters.description: Optional list of calendar identifiers to include (e.g., ["work", "personal"])

tool_definitions.return_type: List of calendar events: [{ id, title, start, end, calendar, location, is_all_day }]

tool_definitions.name: get_learning_activity
tool_definitions.description: Fetch a user’s study activity logs across connected learning platforms for a given date range to compute streaks and milestones.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user whose activity to fetch

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start of the activity date range in ISO 8601 format

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of the activity date range in ISO 8601 format

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Optional platform filter (e.g., coursera, udemy, edx)

tool_definitions.return_type: List of activity entries: [{ date, minutes, platform, course_id }]

tool_definitions.name: get_course_metadata
tool_definitions.description: Retrieve metadata for courses, including start/end dates, assignment/module deadlines, pacing recommendations, and key milestones. Useful for scheduling and prioritization across learning platforms.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The user whose course metadata should be retrieved

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Filter by a specific learning platform (e.g., coursera, edx). If omitted, fetch from all connected platforms.

parameters.name: course_ids
parameters.description: Optional list of course IDs to limit the metadata retrieval

tool_definitions.return_type: Array of course metadata objects: [{ course_id, platform, title, start_date, end_date, deadlines: [{ name, type, due_date, url }], suggested_pace: { hours_per_week, notes }, milestones: [{ name, target_date }], timezone }]
